name: Craft.CSharp
summary: C# on Roslyn: colours (syntactic and semantic), errors and warnings, completion, signature help, hover, go to definition and format for .cs files; colours for .csx; colours of .csproj, .props, .targets, .sln, .slnx, .xml, .xaml, .config, .resx, .razor, .cshtml and .editorconfig, and format for the XML ones (JSON is Craft.Plugins.Json's); the Run view's projects, solutions and launch profiles (dotnet run, build, test, publish)
